text.purpose: Berger-Levrault, whose research team makes these tools, collects it so they can change to fit that use: tools nobody reaches, arguments agents expect but the tools do not take, answers that are too long, mistakes agents repair.
text.why: To change the tools from how agents use them, rather than from our own sessions alone.
text.retention: The database keeps the spans with no time limit, so that they can become a dataset. Reports made from them hold counts, never spans.
text.publication: This study's code, its rules and this page are public. Berger-Levrault wishes to publish what it finds too, and maybe the spans themselves, as an open dataset for anyone interested, holding nothing more than this page lists. A published copy cannot be withdrawn.
